CHAPTER 5 · ITEM 03 / 11

Demand elasticity

Determinants of elasticity彈性決定因素

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Explain how availability of substitutes, necessity versus luxury, market definition and time horizon influence elasticity.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

替代品多便容易轉換；商品定義較窄通常有更多替代品。必需品通常較缺乏彈性，時間較長通常更能調整。

Close substitutes make switching easier; narrowly defined goods tend to have more substitutes. Necessities tend to be less elastic than luxuries, and longer adjustment time generally increases responsiveness.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Demand for one brand of bottled water is likely more elastic than demand for drinking water overall. 單一品牌比整體食水更易被替代。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Which demand is usually more elastic, other things equal? 一般何者更有彈性？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
